14114.html:
14114 *hiru 'yellow, green'. [Cf. hiri- in cmpds. (híri- śmaśru-, hiriśiprá- RV.). — hári-]
    G. harvũ 'green'; M. hirvā 'green, raw, unripe'. — Kt. zəŕə 'yellow', Bashg. zĩr and Pr. žiᵊrä: prob. < hári-. — H. hirār 'green, raw, fresh' poss. < *hiratara- (or metath. from harīr < *haritara- ?).
    *HIL 'be accustomed to': *hilati², *hēlayati, *hēlā-.
